name: infracortex
description: Terraform (Azure), Kubernetes, Docker and FinOps tools for Claude Desktop: scans, Docker fix-loop diagnostics, INR Azure pricing, official-icon Azure diagrams.
long_description: Runs the InfraCortex toolkit's scanners on YOUR machine as MCP tools: tf_scan, k8s_triage (read-only), docker_audit, docker_verify (build → run → health → DIAG codes), finops_scan (az login), az_price (Azure Retail Prices in INR, no login), azure_diagram (.drawio/PNG with official Azure icons), validate_report and check_command. Paths are restricted to the workspace folder you choose; scripts run with argument arrays, never through a shell string.

tools.name: tf_scan
tools.description: Terraform scan: fmt, validate, tflint, trivy/checkov, AST checks, rule-ID findings

tools.name: k8s_triage
tools.description: Read-only Kubernetes triage or static manifest review

tools.name: docker_audit
tools.description: Dockerfile / image / container security + efficiency audit

tools.name: docker_verify
tools.description: Build, run, wait for health, print DIAG codes and fix hints

tools.name: finops_scan
tools.description: Azure waste, Advisor, budgets, actual cost; Infracost; AKS rightsizing

tools.name: az_price
tools.description: Azure Retail Prices lookup in INR (or any currency), presets + fx

tools.name: azure_diagram
tools.description: Official-Azure-icon diagrams: spec from Terraform, render drawio/png/svg

tools.name: check_command
tools.description: Guard rules: deny / ask / allow for a shell command

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Folder with your Terraform / manifests / Dockerfiles. Tools can only read or write inside it.

currency.title: Cost currency
currency.description: 3-letter code for prices (Azure Retail Prices API), e.g. INR, USD, EUR.

bash_path.title: Bash path (Windows: Git Bash)
bash_path.description: Leave empty to auto-detect (C:\Program Files\Git\bin\bash.exe on Windows).

python_path.title: Python command
python_path.description: Leave empty for python (Windows) / python3 (macOS, Linux).
